_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Pagsugod ka hin {start_chips} chips
• Single deck hin 52 baraha (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Magmumulay ka patok han dealer (house)
• Kada round susunod han Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure: magpo-post ka hin ANTE ngan BLIND bets, makakarawat ka hin 2 hole cards, magdedesisyon ka hin optional PLAY bets ha mga betting phase, tapos ig-reveal an mga community cards ngan ikumpara an imo best 5-card hand patok han dealer’s. An imo goal amo an pag-maximize han imo winnings (kun ikaw an mayda mas maupay nga kamot), samtang pag-minimize han imo losses (kun ikaw an mayda mas maluya nga kamot).
• Game natapos kun ikaw nakarawat hin 0 chips o ubos pa ha pagsugod han round (LOSS) o nakumpleto ka hin 1000 rounds hin chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet kada round
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet kada round
• PLAY: Optional bet ha gameplay. Ha kada round, pwede ka magpili hin usa la han mga nagsunod: (${ante4} kun ginbuhat ha PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} kun ginbuhat ha FLOP, o ${ante} kun ginbuhat ha RIVER. Pwede ka gihapon mag-fold ha river, paghatag hin kamot, ngan paghimo hin waray bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Makakarawat ka hin 2 face-up cards (an imo hole cards)
• Dealer makakarawat hin 2 face-down cards (tinago ha imo)
• 5 community cards gin-deal face-down ha una
• Community cards gin-reveal progresibo ha mga game phase

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer kinahanglan mayda at least usa ka PAIR (2 baraha hin pareho nga rank) para ma-qualify, gamit an 2 baraha ha ira kamot ngan an 5 community cards.
• Dealer qualification naapektohan an mga betting outcome, samtang ige-eksplika ha sunod.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Mga aksyon: [4x] (${ante4}) o [check]
  • [4x]: Maghimo hin ${ante4} PLAY bet, ig-reveal an mga unang 3 community cards
  • [check]: Waray karagdagang bet, ig-reveal an mga unang 3 community cards

📋 FLOP:
  • Kun 4x bet ginbuhat: Usa la [skip] an available (auto-reveal an mga huring 2 community cards)
  • Kun waray 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) o [check]
  • [2x]: Maghimo hin ${ante2} PLAY bet, ig-reveal an mga huring 2 community cards
  • [check]: Waray karagdagang bet, ig-reveal an mga huring 2 community cards

📋 RIVER:
  • Kun 4x o 2x bet ginbuhat: Usa la [skip] an available (auto-proceed ha showdown)
  • Kun waray prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) o [fold]
  • [1x]: Maghimo hin ${ante} PLAY bet, mag-proceed ha showdown
  • [fold]: Paghatag hin kamot, mawawara an ANTE ngan BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • An tanan mga baraha gin-reveal ngan ige-evaluate
  • An best 5-card hand tikang ha 7 baraha (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Mga bet gin-settle sumala han payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer waray qualify: PUSH (bet ginbalik)
  • Dealer qualify ngan ikaw an nakadaog: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualify ngan ikaw an nakaperdi: Bet nawawara
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ginbalik)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Waray apektado han dealer qualification
  • Ikaw an nakadaog: Bet ginbalik ngan karagdagang payout sumala han imo kamot
  • Ikaw an nakaperdi: Bet nawawara
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ginbalik)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Waray karagdagang payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Waray apektado han dealer qualification
  • Direkta nga komparasyon: An imo best hand patok han dealer's best hand
  • Ikaw an nakadaog: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Ikaw an nakaperdi: Bet nawawara
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ginbalik)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 hin pareho nga suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 sunod-sunod nga baraha hin pareho nga suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 baraha hin pareho nga rank
  4. Full House: 3 hin pareho nga rank + 2 hin pareho nga rank
  5. Flush: 5 baraha hin pareho nga suit
  6. Straight: 5 sunod-sunod nga baraha
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 baraha hin pareho nga rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pareho nga rank hin baraha
  9. One Pair: 2 baraha hin pareho nga rank
  10. High Card: An gihataasi nga baraha an nakadaog

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] o [play bet 4x]: Maghimo hin ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] o [play bet 2x]: Maghimo hin ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] o [play bet 1x]: Maghimo hin ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] o [c]: Check (waray karagdagang bet)
• [fold] o [f]: Fold (paghatag hin kamot)
• [skip] o [s]: Skip ha sunod nga phase (kun waray aksyon kinahanglan)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Mga kusog nga pagsugod nga kamot (pareho, hataas nga baraha) madalas nagpapahimo hin 4x bets
• Iksamin an dealer qualification - mga maluya nga kamot pwede mag-push kun dealer waray qualify
• BLIND bet pwede magin profitable hin kusog nga kamot (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Bantayi an imo chip stack! Kun mag-ubos ha 0 o ubos pa ha pagsugod han round, ikaw an nakaperdi.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE ngan BLIND bets mandatory kada round
• PLAY bets optional ngan strategic
• Siguraduhin an imo input han aksyon, ngan usa la an aksyon ha usa ka panahon.
